notes.title: Super Fantasy Kingdom Release Date Announcement!!
notes.notes:
Greetings, rulers!

Following a legendary appearance at Steam Next Fest, where Feryaz Beer’s roguelike city-builder became one of the most-played demos, we are excited to announce the release window for Super Fantasy Kingdom. 

The battle for your kingdom begins in Q1 2025.
The Next Fest demo is still live for another week, so this is your last chance to dive into the adventure and experience the magic firsthand!

Wishlist now and play later!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2289750/Super_Fantasy_Kingdom/

[hr][/hr]Games Baked in Germany
Super Fantasy Kingdom will also be featured in the "Games Baked in Germany" Steam event from June 20 to June 27. This event showcases over 250 incredible games developed in Germany, including many award-winning titles.

Don't miss the brand-new trailer for Super Fantasy Kingdom that premiered during the "Games Baked in Germany" showcase on Steam and IGN's YouTube channel.
